name: enemies-r2
note: BL-17, the Demon redrawn on the owner's notes of 2026-11-12: it holds NOTHING (a held object makes trouble for animation later), both arms at its sides, far less muscular, less wide. One candidate (the house rule). Refs add the first Demon (enemies-r1 candidate 1) for the head, horns and colours. The Spider redrawn the same day: a higher three-quarter camera, like the buildings and deco, so more of the spider is seen (owner).

demon.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached COW on magenta is one of this game's animals: match its rendering (soft painterly, flat colour with gentle shading, soft thick outlines, no texture, no background). STYLE REFERENCE, the most important image: the attached farm man on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game. The new creature must look drawn by the same hand on the same day, for the same storybook: the same chunky doll proportion (a big head, large expressive eyes, a short thick body, small feet), the same soft rendering; never realistic, never anatomical, never gory. THIS IS AN ENEMY the player fights: menacing in a storybook way (a scowl, bared teeth, a glare), but still charming and readable, something a child would call a monster and not be frightened by; no blood, no wounds. VIEW, the rule for every enemy (unlike this game's farm animals, which are drawn side-on): FRONT-FACING, like the player characters: upright and facing the viewer, the body square-ish to the viewer with a FAINT three-quarter turn, the head and the eyes turned a little toward the viewer's RIGHT, standing on ONE flat ground line, left and right sides roughly symmetrical, nothing trailing far outside the body's silhouette. SUBJECT: a tall DEMON. DESIGN REFERENCE: the attached red demon is the FIRST drawing of this enemy: keep its head, face, horns, colours and goat legs, and CHANGE its body as written here. Deep crimson-red skin, two big curved black horns, glowing yellow eyes under a heavy brow, a wide fanged grin, a small black chin beard. BUILD: tall and broad-shouldered but NOT a bodybuilder: a plain smooth barrel chest and a plain belly drawn as simple rounded shapes, no bulging muscles, no six-pack, no veins, arms of ordinary thickness; the same soft doll build as the reference farm man, only bigger. ARMS: BOTH arms hang straight DOWN at its sides, relaxed, hands open beside the hips with short black claws; the hands are EMPTY: it holds NOTHING, no fire, no flame, no weapon, no object of any kind, and neither arm is raised. Small charcoal bat wings folded SHUT close behind the shoulders, their tips barely showing past the upper arms, never spread. Shaggy black goat legs ending in black hooves, standing with the hooves close together under the body; a thin tail with a spade tip hanging close behind one leg. The whole figure is a NARROW upright shape: clearly taller than it is wide, about half as wide as it is tall. Keep it at the game's scale: it is seen about 45 pixels wide on the board, so big plain shapes, a strong silhouette, flat areas of colour, no fine detail, no small accessories. COLOUR: bright and saturated; never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on it. The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field with a thin grid, a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle (one board tile) and a dashed half-height box directly above it (the headroom); the reference character stands in that box with its head in the headroom. ONE FIGURE ONLY, nothing else in the picture: no building, no props on the ground, no scene. Draw it standing on the box's bottom edge and bigger than the reference character: about one and a half times as tall and only a little broader, its feet inside the box, its horns near the top of the headroom; the arms and wings stay close to the body, nothing reaches out sideways. A soft contact shadow directly under it; leave every other pixel pure solid magenta: no grass, no ground, no frame, no text.
